ECONOMIC_COMPENSATION.description: The entry quantity is the average monthly wage over the 12 months before termination. Service is measured from the contract start through the incurred date: a full year pays one month, six months or more pays one, and any shorter part pays half. A wage above 3× the local monthly average pays at that figure for at most 12 years (劳动合同法 第四十七条); any other wage pays in full for all its years.

references.title: 劳动合同法 第四十六条、第四十七条; 实施条例 第二十七条: 每满一年一个月工资, 六个月以上不满一年按一年, 不满六个月半个月; 高于当地上年度职工月平均工资三倍的按三倍, 年限最高12年.

PAY_IN_LIEU_OF_NOTICE.description: The entry quantity is the employee's wage for the previous month, paid instead of 30 days' notice.

references.title: 劳动合同法 第四十条; 实施条例 第二十条: 额外支付一个月工资, 按劳动者上一个月的工资标准确定.

ANNUAL_BONUS.description: The entry quantity is the annual one-time bonus awarded for the year. By default it joins cumulative comprehensive income. With the employee election `annual_bonus_separate` it stays out of that base and IIT_ANNUAL_BONUS taxes it alone. One bonus a year: pay anything else as BONUS.

references.title: 国税发〔2005〕9号 第一条; 财政部 税务总局公告2023年第30号: 全年一次性奖金可单独计税, 至2027-12-31.
Calculation note: Method B is implemented; Method A is available under 财税〔2018〕164号 and 财政部 税务总局公告2023年第30号 (extended to 2027-12-31) but is not modelled by this catalogue.

BONUS.description: The entry quantity is the bonus paid with the month.

references.title: 国家统计局《关于工资总额组成的规定》第七条; 个人所得税法 第二条: 奖金属于工资、薪金所得.

DAMAGE_COMPENSATION_DEDUCTION.description: The entry quantity is the assessed economic loss. The deduction is capped at 20% of the contract monthly wage and must leave the local minimum wage (工资支付暂行规定 第十六条).

references.title: 工资支付暂行规定 第十六条: 每月扣除不超过当月工资20%, 且扣除后不低于当地最低工资; 上海 沪人社综发〔2016〕29号 第二十二条.

UNLAWFUL_TERMINATION_COMPENSATION.description: The entry quantity is the average monthly wage. Compensation is twice the 经济补偿 count over the whole period of service (劳动合同法 第八十七条), with the 3× wage and 12-year cap of 第四十七条 where the wage is above it.

references.title: 劳动合同法 第四十八条、第八十七条; 实施条例 第二十五条: 按经济补偿标准的二倍支付, 不再支付经济补偿.

MATERNITY_ALLOWANCE_PASSTHROUGH.description: The entry quantity is the maternity allowance the fund pays through the employer. Female employees only.

references.title: 财税〔2008〕8号: 生育津贴、生育医疗费免征个人所得税.

EARLY_RETIREMENT_LUMP_SUM.description: The entry quantity is the lump sum paid on early retirement.

references.title: 财税〔2018〕164号 五(二): 提前退休一次性补贴按至法定退休年龄实际年度数分摊, 单独适用综合所得税率表.

WAGE_ARREARS_PENALTY.description: The entry quantity is the assessed additional compensation the labour bureau ordered: 50% to 100% of the unpaid sum (劳动合同法 第八十五条).

references.title: 劳动合同法 第八十五条: 逾期不支付, 按应付金额50%以上100%以下加付赔偿金.

WORK_INJURY_DISABILITY_SUBSIDY.description: The entry quantity is the one-off disability subsidy the authority assesses.

references.title: 工伤保险条例 第三十六条、第三十七条; 沪府令第93号 第四十条、第四十一条 (18/15/12/9/6/3个月, 临近退休每年减20%); 云政发〔2011〕255号 第三十六至三十八条 (33/29/22/18/13/7个月).

MATERNITY_TOPUP.description: The entry quantity is the shortfall between the pre-leave wage and the maternity allowance received. Female employees only.

INTERNAL_RETIREMENT_LUMP_SUM.description: The entry quantity is the lump sum paid on internal retirement.

references.title: 财税〔2018〕164号 五(三); 国税发〔1999〕58号: 内部退养一次性补贴按至法定退休年龄月份平均, 与当月工资合并确定税率.

NON_COMPETE_COMPENSATION.description: The entry quantity is the monthly non-compete compensation. It is payable only after the contract ends and for at most two years.

references.title: 劳动合同法 第二十三条、第二十四条; 法释〔2020〕26号 第三十六条: 竞业限制期限不超过二年, 未约定补偿的按前十二个月平均工资30%按月支付.

WORK_INJURY_DISABILITY_ALLOWANCE.description: The entry quantity is the monthly disability allowance the employer assesses.

// 劳动法 art.50: wages are paid at least monthly, so a pay date never falls over a month after the period it pays.
return String(ctx.entry.pay_date) <= add_months(String(ctx.entry.salary_coverage.to), 1);

return ctx.reads.leave_catalog.some((row) => row.code === ctx.entry.catalog_code && row.code === 'ANNUAL_LEAVE');

comprehensive_overtime_review.description: Required each payroll month for COMPREHENSIVE hours; unsupported or incomplete cycle history must be reviewed before payroll can proceed.

month.title: Payroll month reviewed
month.description: YYYY-MM of this review, including a zero-due review in a non-settlement month.

settlement_on.title: Settlement day
settlement_on.description: Cycle end or termination day in the reviewed month. The period covering this day pays the reviewed hours once.

excess_nonholiday_hours.title: Reviewed unpaid cycle excess hours
excess_nonholiday_hours.description: Actual cycle hours above the lawful standard after holiday/credited-absence treatment, less excess hours already paid. Reviewed from the approval and complete attendance history; never the sum of outside-shift overtime alone.

reference.title: Approval, attendance and calculation evidence
reference.description: Reference to the approved cycle and reviewed hours calculation, including incomplete-cycle termination where applicable.

annual_leave_year_reviews.title: Annual-leave decisions by calendar year
annual_leave_year_reviews.description: One reviewed row per year; retain prior years because current entitlement reads the preceding decision. No matching review blocks payroll/annual-leave availability. https://rsj.sh.gov.cn/trlzyhshbzbgz_17256/20200617/t0035_1388390.html

year.title: Calendar year
year.description: Calendar year covered by the reviewed leave decision.

disqualified.title: No statutory leave this year
disqualified.description: Reviewed current-year disqualification under 条例第四条 or 实施办法第八条. Already consumed units remain represented; they do not create new availability.

next_year_disqualified.title: Following year disqualified
next_year_disqualified.description: 实施办法第八条: annual leave was used before the disqualifying paid personal/sick leave occurred; the next year has no new statutory grant.

waived_days.title: Unused days declined in writing for personal reasons
waived_days.description: Up to this many current-year unused days: employer arranged leave; employee declined in writing for their own reasons (第十条第二款). These days are consumed without extra pay and never carried.

deferred_days.title: Unused days agreed to defer once
deferred_days.description: Up to this many current-year unused days, after any valid waiver, deferred by agreement because of work needs (第九条). They leave this year and join the next, and cannot be deferred a second time.

reference.title: Reviewed decision and supporting evidence
reference.description: Evidence of annual review, disqualification sequence, employer-arranged leave/personal written refusal or work-need deferral consent, as applicable.

job_salary.title: Job salary for probation comparison
job_salary.description: 劳动合同法 第二十条: the wage for the same post; probation pay must reach 80% of it or the post minimum, whichever applies.

medical_period_review.title: Medical-period review reference
medical_period_review.description: 劳部发〔1994〕479号 第三条: reviewed medical-treatment period and its expiry; required once sick leave exceeds 65 days.

work_injury_leave_extension.title: Work-injury leave extension review
work_injury_leave_extension.description: 工伤保险条例 第三十三条第二款: reviewed extension beyond 12 months; required once work-injury leave exceeds 365 days.

prior_employment.title: Prior employment in the tax year (本年内以前任职受雇)
prior_employment.description: One row per prior employment period in the tax year. 国家税务总局公告2018年第61号 第六条: only months already withheld by this same withholding agent join the monthly cumulative withholding; another withholding agent's income and tax are combined only at the annual reconciliation (个人所得税法 第十一条) and must not be added to a monthly cumulative base. Do not repeat months already recorded by this payroll's payslips.

tax_year.title: Tax year of the prior period

months.title: Months withheld in the tax year
months.description: Months in the tax year during which that withholding agent paid this employee. Used only when same_withholding_agent is true.

gross_income.title: Wage income paid by that agent
gross_income.description: Gross wage income before the employee's social insurance and housing-fund contributions.

employee_social_contributions.title: Employee social insurance and housing-fund contributions withheld
employee_social_contributions.description: Pension, medical, unemployment and housing-fund contributions already deducted from that income.

same_withholding_agent.title: Same withholding agent as this employer
same_withholding_agent.description: True only when the prior period was under this same withholding agent (an earlier contract or a payroll migration), not a different employer. True joins the monthly cumulative withholding; false stays for the annual reconciliation.

sick_pay_share.title: Agreed sick pay share of the wage
sick_pay_share.description: 劳部发〔1995〕309号 第59条: the law sets only a floor of 80% of the minimum wage. A higher share in the contract, collective contract or handbook binds.

medical_period_extension.title: Medical-period extension approval

protected_until.description: 劳动合同法 第四十二条: pregnancy, medical treatment period or work injury; termination is refused before this date.
